scenes.narration: In this town, your shadow must NEVER move differently from you after sunset.
Everyone knows the rule. Because once your shadow moves on its own, it means something is coming to take your place.
My name is Alex, and I thought it was just another stupid town legend.
Until one night, at exactly 9 PM, I raised my hand. But my shadow didn’t. Instead... it waved at me.
I ran home as fast as I could.
But when I opened my bedroom door, someone was already standing inside. It looked exactly like me. Same clothes. Same face.
But something was wrong. It had no shadow. I turned around to run. And suddenly, every light in the house went out.
The next morning, I ran outside. The sun was shining. Everyone had a shadow. Except me.
Then I noticed something terrifying. My shadow was standing behind my bedroom window. And it was waving again.
